facts.text: Evan acknowledges that feeling overwhelmed is okay and encourages Sam to take small steps forward.

evidence.quote: It's okay to feel overwhelmed, Sam. Just keep moving forward slowly and taking small steps. You're doing awesome.
No worries, just keep going and taking it one step at a time! You'll get there.

facts.text: Sam expresses gratitude to Evan for his encouragement and states that he will continue to take things one step at a time.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Evan, your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll keep going and take it one step at a time!

facts.text: Sam mentions feeling a mix of emotions, including concern about his health and motivation to make positive changes.

evidence.quote: I have been feeling a mix of emotions - somewhat concerned about my health but also motivated to make positive changes. Taking things one step at a time.
